title: Bonnie Tyler dies – level 1
paragraphs: Bonnie Tyler is a very famous singer. She is from Wales. She dies. She is 75 years old. She is in a hospital in Portugal because she is sick.

Her family and fans are very sad today. Bonnie is famous for her great songs like Total Eclipse of the Heart. Everyone knows Bonnie because she has a very special, deep voice. She loves to sing for young and old people, and she is very kind to her fans.
Today, millions of people still listen to her music on their computers and phones. She is a great star. People will never forget her beautiful songs.
